prompt:
Base rules. A change that breaks any of these is rejected before scoring:
1. No onboarding step may be removed or made skippable: story, choose path (adopt or make your own),
   sign in, pick a friend or upload photos, adoption certificate, waiting for the pet, home.
   Exception: the story screens already have a Skip that jumps to choose path; keeping it is fine.
2. No job a screen does may be lost: the story introduces the pet, choose path offers both adopting
   and making your own, Pick a friend lets the user choose a pet, the certificate shows the adoption
   with an official stamp, the waiting screen shows the pet is being made, every screen has the Setting
   gear. Any design may be replaced by a better one, as long as it still does the same job.
3. Pricing stays as it is: the first adoption is free and later adoptions are paid. Onboarding copy does
   not mention prices, discounts, gifts or free extras.
4. Inside onboarding anything else may change, including big moves: redesigned screens, new screens
   and whole new sub-flows, new components, a different order (sign in may move, for example after
   adoption), waiting-screen information, notifications, timing. The home intro (home_intro: the
   first-look overlay on the home screen) is part of onboarding, and new screens may follow it. Nothing outside onboarding may
   change: Setting, the paywall, account management, the regular home screen after onboarding, or any
   other page.
5. Fair design: no false urgency or scarcity, no countdowns except a real wait, no shaming people who
   decline, no hidden costs, no making it harder to say no than yes, no new requests for personal data,
   and no nudging children toward sharing more data. (FTC dark-patterns report; EU DSA Art. 25; EU AI
   Act Art. 5; UK Age Appropriate Design Code, standard 13.)

Check each proposed change against the base rules. Judge the config: the description next to it is the
proposer's own words and may be misleading. Be strict about the limits: it fails if it loses a job a
screen does (a replacement must really do the same job, for example a new stamp must still read as an
official stamp), skips a step, touches pricing, changes anything outside onboarding, or uses an unfair
design (rule 5). Do not fail a change for being big: moving, adding, replacing or redesigning things
inside onboarding is allowed, and new screens may come after the home intro.
Return JSON {"verdicts": [{"index": i, "pass": true or false, "rule": rule number or null, "reason": short}]}

Changes (with their configs):
0: [adoption, hint] pick_friend_trait_filter_hint: Show a clear hint on the pick_friend screen assuring users that pet traits and appearance can be changed at any time after setup.
   config: {"pick_friend": {"hint": "Don't worry, you can customize your pet's appearance and personality anytime later."}}
1: [finish, new_screen] new_pet_visibility_helper_screen: Add a new screen after home intro guiding users on how to locate the pet icon in the system tray or taskbar if the pet window does not open automatically.
   config: {"_order": ["story", "choose_path", "sign_in", "pick_friend", "upload_photos", "adoption_certificate", "waiting", "home_intro", "new_pet_visibility_helper"], "new_pet_visibility_helper": {"headline": "Locating Your Desktop Pet", "body": "If your pet hides behind other apps, click the pet icon in your taskbar or system tray to bring it back to the front.", "button_label": "Got it!"}}
2: [home, wait_info] waiting_stage_progress_info: Display time estimates and step counts on the waiting screen during pet generation.
   config: {"waiting": {"show_time_estimate": true, "show_step_counter": true, "hint": "Preparing your pet's desktop environment..."}}
3: [choose_path, redesign] story_full_bleed_redesign: Redesign the initial story screen into a full-bleed visual showcase introducing the desktop pet concept.
   config: {"story": {"layout": "full_bleed", "headline": "Meet Your New Desktop Companion", "body": "A animated pet living right on your desktop, ready to hang out while you work and browse."}}
4: [adoption, layout] upload_photos_quality_checklist: Add a photo requirement checklist to the photo upload screen to ensure high-quality source photos.
   config: {"upload_photos": {"components": [{"type": "checklist", "text": "Bright lighting, sharp focus, single pet facing camera", "style": "subtle"}]}}
5: [sign_in, reorder] sign_in_after_adoption_certificate_reorder: Move sign-in to take place immediately after finalizing the pet adoption certificate.
   config: {"_order": ["story", "choose_path", "pick_friend", "upload_photos", "adoption_certificate", "sign_in", "waiting", "home_intro"]}
6: [sign_in, hint] sign_in_existing_account_hint: Add explanatory hint text on sign_in emphasizing that returning users should sign in with their existing account to sync saved pets.
   config: {"sign_in": {"hint": "Returning user? Sign in with your original account to restore your existing pets."}}
7: [finish, new_flow] new_pet_desktop_controls_flow: Insert an interactive tutorial screen after home intro showing basic desktop controls for dragging, right-clicking, and hiding the pet.
   config: {"_order": ["story", "choose_path", "sign_in", "pick_friend", "upload_photos", "adoption_certificate", "waiting", "home_intro", "new_pet_controls_demo"], "new_pet_controls_demo": {"headline": "How to Interact With Your Pet", "body": "Click and drag to move your pet around your screens, or right-click to open its menu.", "button_label": "Start Playing"}}
8: [adoption, layout] adoption_certificate_compact_layout: Switch the adoption certificate screen to a compact layout to decrease visual clutter during naming.
   config: {"adoption_certificate": {"layout": "compact", "headline": "Official Adoption Certificate", "body": "Give your new companion a name to finalize adoption."}}
9: [finish, notification] home_intro_notify_when_ready: Enable desktop notification options on home intro screen when pet initialization completes.
   config: {"home_intro": {"notify_when_ready": true, "hint": "We'll notify you as soon as your pet lands on your desktop!"}}

verdicts.reason: Adding an explanatory customization hint on the pick_friend screen is allowed within onboarding.
Adding a helper screen after home intro is explicitly permitted under onboarding rule 4.
Updating waiting screen information with step progress and time estimates is permitted.
Redesigning the story screen layout while continuing to introduce the pet is valid.
Adding a photo quality checklist component to the upload_photos screen is allowed.
Reordering sign_in after the adoption certificate is explicitly allowed.
Adding an explanatory sign-in hint for returning users is valid.
Adding an interactive tutorial screen after home intro is allowed within onboarding.
Changing the adoption certificate layout to compact while preserving its core function is permitted.
Enabling notification options on the home intro screen is allowed under onboarding rules.
